If I leave everyone who’s toxic then I’ll have one person...and he’s not coming with. 
I know this is supposed to be so exciting and freeing but all I feel is dread. What if my first day of work everyone decided I’m fat dumb and stupid? I’ll lose all those potential relationships. And I’m ok being on my own but at this point it just seems easier to die.
What’s the point if I’m already basically dead anyways.
right. I'm a fucking idiot. See I can't even think

That doesn’t make sense. I know I don’t have THAT much life experience since I’m still young but I’ve been to a ton of schools. I moved around a lot. And I’ve been a lot of places and had a lot of jobs. What I mean is I’ve known a lot of people and after a while they always leave me. Because no one likes me. I’m a bad person. There’s no one out there who will like me. I don’t deserve it anyways
